## AI/ML map of the ESS

```{r , echo=F, message=F, warning=F}

library(dplyr)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)
library(htmlwidgets)


####################### GET COUNTRY SHAPES

# Import a map. This is actually the whole world, crop to Europe later
eu_map_1 <- bind_rows(ne_countries( scale = 'medium', returnclass = 'sf') )

# This is WGS 84, the right projection for leaflet
# st_crs(eu_map_1)

# Define a bounding box for France to exclude territories that are far away, since these cause the 
# centroid to fall outside the main part of France
france_box <- st_bbox(c(xmin = -10,ymin =30, xmax= 12,ymax = 60), crs = st_crs(4326)) |> 
  st_as_sfc()

# ggplot(eu_map_1 |> filter(sovereignt=='France')) + geom_sf() + 
#   geom_sf(data = france_box , colour='red', fill=NA)

# Fix France and names of some other countries
eu_map_2 <- bind_rows(
  eu_map_1 |> filter(sovereignt!='France'),
  eu_map_1 |> filter(sovereignt=='France') |> 
    st_intersection(france_box)) |> 
  mutate(sovereignt = case_when(
    sovereignt=='Republic of Serbia' ~ 'Serbia',
    admin=='Turkey' ~ 'Turkey',
    admin=='Cyprus' ~ 'Cyprus',
    T ~ sovereignt
  ))

rm(france_box)



####################### MAKE HEX GRID

# Make hexes in 3035, but project them in 4326

hex_grid <- st_make_grid(eu_map_2|> st_transform(3035) , square = F, n = c(500,500)) 
hex_grid <- st_sf(geometry = hex_grid) |> 
  mutate(hex_num=row_number())

europe_box <- st_bbox(c(xmin = 2200000,ymin =1380000, xmax= 6500000,ymax = 5500000), crs = st_crs(3035)) |> 
  st_as_sfc()

hex_grid <- hex_grid |> filter(hex_num %in% st_intersects(europe_box ,hex_grid)[[1]])

rm(europe_box)

# ggplot(eu_map_2|> st_transform(3035) ) + geom_sf() + 
#   geom_sf(data =hex_grid , colour = 'red', fill=NA) +
#   coord_sf(xlim = c(2200000, 6500000) , ylim = c(1380000, 5500000)) 



####################### GET CENTRE POINTS OF EACH COUNTRY


countries_of_interest <- c("France","Estonia","Serbia","Hungary","Iceland","Lithuania","Belgium","Austria","Denmark","Portugal",
"Sweden","Poland","Luxembourg","Liechtenstein","Netherlands","Slovenia","Italy","Czechia","Switzerland","Malta","Germany",
"Norway","Turkey","Spain","Croatia","Cyprus","Ireland")

# removing from above: "Canada",

# Get coords for centre of each country. Needed for finding closest hexes to each country
country_centres <- eu_map_2 |> 
  st_transform(3035) |> 
  arrange(sovereignt, scalerank, labelrank) |> 
  slice(1, .by=sovereignt) |> 
  st_centroid() |> 
  select(sovereignt, name) |>
  filter(sovereignt %in% countries_of_interest) 

# ggplot(eu_map_2|> st_transform(3035) ) + geom_sf() + 
#   geom_sf(data =hex_grid , colour = 'red', fill=NA) +
#   geom_sf(data= country_centres, colour = 'blue') +
#   coord_sf(xlim = c(2200000, 6500000) , ylim = c(1380000, 5500000)) 



####################### GET CENTRE POINTS OF EACH HEX

# Need to get centres of hexes too, so that we can check distance to centres of countries. 
hex_centres <- hex_grid %>% 
  st_centroid() %>%  
  rename(coords=1) %>%
  mutate(x = st_coordinates(.)[,1], y = st_coordinates(.)[,2]) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()



####################### CREATE DATASET OF PROJECTS


# Now we create a dataset which represents 5 projects per country.
# Normally this would be a CSV which would be attached to the centres dataset.
# Note that this is based on country_centres which is 3035
aiml_projects_1 <- country_centres %>% 
  mutate(x = st_coordinates(.)[,1] , y = st_coordinates(.)[,2] ) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  bind_rows(.,.,.,.,.) |> # this is where duplicates are made
  arrange(sovereignt) |> 
  mutate(proj_id = row_number()) |> 
  group_by(sovereignt) |> 
  mutate(proj_title = paste0('Sample project ', proj_id),
         category  = sample(c('LLM', 'Earth Observation', 'Classification'), size = n(), replace=T),
         proj_label = paste0('<h2>',proj_title , '</h2><br>' , 'This ', category,' project from ',sovereignt,' does x, y and z')) |> 
  ungroup()



####################### FIND NEAREST HEXES TO EACH COUNTRY


# Now we have to find the hexes which will occupy each of the projects

for(i in 1:nrow(aiml_projects_1)){  
  if(i==1){
    hex_gone_list <- c(1)
    hex_list <- list()
  }
  # print(str_c(i , ' of ', nrow(aiml_projects_1)))
  org_hex_pair <- hex_centres %>%
    filter(! hex_num %in% hex_gone_list) %>%
    mutate(x0 = aiml_projects_1$x[i] , y0= aiml_projects_1$y[i], proj_id = aiml_projects_1$proj_id[i],
           dist = sqrt(    ((x0-x)^2)   +    ((y0-y)^2)   ) ) %>%
    filter(dist == min(dist)) 
  hex_gone_list <- c(hex_gone_list , org_hex_pair$hex_num[1])
  
  hex_list[[i]] <- org_hex_pair
  rm(org_hex_pair)
}


##################### PREPARE DATASET FOR PLOT

# From bind_rows(hex_list) we get the hex_num.
# From hex_grid we get the geometry of the hexes.
# From aiml_projects_1 we get the project details. 

aiml_projects_2 <- hex_grid |> 
  inner_join(bind_rows(hex_list) |> select(hex_num, proj_id), by='hex_num') |> 
  inner_join(aiml_projects_1 |> select(name, proj_title ,proj_label, proj_id, category), by='proj_id')

aiml_projects_2$proj_label <- sprintf('%s',aiml_projects_2$proj_label) %>% lapply(htmltools::HTML)

aiml_projects_2 <- st_transform(aiml_projects_2 , crs= 4326)

# ggplot(eu_map_2|> st_transform(3035) ) + geom_sf() + 
#   geom_sf(data =aiml_projects_2 |> st_transform(3035) , aes(fill=category)) +
#   coord_sf(xlim = c(2200000, 6500000) , ylim = c(1380000, 5500000))

labels_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(setNames(as.list(as.character(aiml_projects_2$proj_label)), aiml_projects_2$proj_id),auto_unbox = TRUE)

##################### MAKE PALETTE

pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c(
    `LLM` = "#89AAE6",
    `Classification` = "#3685B5",
    `Earth Observation` = "#AC80A0"
  ),
  domain = aiml_projects_2$category)



##################### MAKE LEAFLET


m <- leaflet(width = "100%", height = 800, options = 
               leafletOptions(crs = leafletCRS(crsClass = "L.Proj.CRS",code = "EPSG:3035",
                                               proj4def = paste("+proj=laea","+lat_0=52","+lon_0=10",
                                                                "+x_0=4321000","+y_0=3210000","+ellps=GRS80",
                                                                "+units=m","+no_defs"),
                                               resolutions = 2^seq(14, 0, by = -0.5),
                                               origin = c(0, 0)), 
                              dragging = FALSE,
                              zoomControl = FALSE,
                              scrollWheelZoom = FALSE,
                              doubleClickZoom = FALSE,
                              boxZoom = FALSE,
                              keyboard = FALSE,
                              touchZoom = FALSE)) |>
  addPolygons(data = eu_map_2,
              # fillColor = "lightgrey",
              fillColor = "#E9EEF2",
              fillOpacity = 1,
              color = "#F5F8FA",
              weight = 2,
              opacity=1) |>
  addPolygons(
    data = aiml_projects_2,
    layerId = ~proj_id  ,
    # fillColor = "steelblue",
    # fillColor =  ~colour,  
    fillColor =  ~pal(category),
    fillOpacity = 1,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 3,
                                        color = "yellow",
                                        bringToFront = TRUE)) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomleft",
    pal = pal,
    opacity = 1,
    values = aiml_projects_2$category,
    title = "Project Category") |>
  
  onRender(sprintf(
    "
function(el,x){
var labels = %s;
this.eachLayer(function(layer){
if(layer.options && layer.options.layerId){
layer.on('click', function(){
var id = layer.options.layerId;
document.getElementById('details-panel').innerHTML =
labels[id];
});
}
});
}
",labels_json)) |> 
  # fitBounds(lng1 = -10,lat1 = 37,lng2 = 40,lat2 = 70)
  setView(lng = 10,lat = 52.5,zoom = 2.5) |> 
  
  htmlwidgets::prependContent(
    htmltools::tags$style(HTML("
        .legend {
        font-size: 16px !important;
        }
        .legend-title {
        font-size: 16px !important;
        font-weight: bold;
        }
        .leaflet-container {
        background: #F5F8FA;
        }
        "))
  )


################################# MAKE PAGE

page <- tagList(
  
  tags$div(
    style = "
display:flex;
flex-direction:column;
height:75vh;
",
    
    tags$div(
      style = "height:85%;",
      as.tags(m)
    ),
    
    tags$div(
      id = "details-panel",
      style = "
height:15%;
padding:20px;
border-top:1px solid #ccc;
overflow-y:auto;
height:100%;
",
      HTML("<h2>Project Details</h2><p>Click a polygon.</p>")
    )
  )
)


# htmltools::save_html(page,file = "html/test.html")

page


```
